audit_criterion: If a finite choice is already impossible from fixed finite state, the question surface must not present it as locally admissible.

A1_exact_stage1_admissibility.detail: n1__seed, n2__seed, and n3__seed are emitted in the same Stage-1 surface from the same seed_options(source); the same non-NONE handle is therefore locally selectable for more than one node slot.

A2_dependency_timing.detail: Cross-slot node-handle uniqueness is not encoded in the Stage-1 choice surface. It is checked only after the complete Stage-1 answer map is wire-validated, when stage2() calls bindings().

A3_contract_consistency.detail: Once a non-NONE referent handle has been selected for one node slot, selecting the identical handle for another slot is already impossible under the frozen unique-handle invariant, yet the simultaneous Stage-1 surface admits that tuple.

A4_bounded_210_linkage.detail: The canonical #210 runner freezes a wire-valid Stage-1 answer artifact before stage2(); all eight reported failures occur when stage2() invokes bindings(). Under the canonical wire path an unknown handle cannot survive parse/check validation, so the combined exception localizes these eight completed-transaction failures to duplicate valid handles.

A5_unknown_handle_branch.detail: An answer not present in the emitted finite criteria is rejected by check_answers/parse_round before bindings(); unknown handles cannot reach the duplicate-or-unknown branch in a wire-valid canonical Stage-1 answer.

A6_synthetic_destructive_witness.detail: A source-free fixture assigning the same valid anchor_span_id::role handle to n1__seed and n2__seed passes Stage-1 finite-answer validation and then fails in bindings() with 'duplicate or unknown node referent handle'.

A7_203_coverage_gap.detail: #203 R1/R2 covered pre-binding referent identity and ambiguity; R3/R4/R5 pruned relation-argument impossibilities. No destructive probe asserted uniqueness of the full node seed handle across multiple Stage-1 node slots.

bounded_descriptive_transition.interpretation: Both same-surface calibrations yielded 0/10 valid ClaimIR. The terminal attrition mode shifted; this is descriptive only and is not a general performance ranking or causal estimate.

candidate_mechanisms: sequential node binding with already-used handles removed from later finite choice sets
